NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera is used to photograph where you parked.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Location is saved with your parking photo.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Pick a photo from your library for your avatar.
NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Location is used in the background to show how far you are from your parked car.
NSContactsUsageDescription: My Parking compares your contacts with member phone numbers and emails to show which friends already use the app. Contacts are not stored.
